text: STACK LANDED at merge 18ebc4b - eight commits, NINE OF FIFTEEN signature fields now carry their support, verified on main. Chief gate on the merged tree, unpiped, SBT_EXIT=0, zero errors, ELEVEN test totals over the full union reference scope: align x2, codec x2, embedBench, embedGrakern, fixtures, interview, recall, view, laws. THE NUMBER THAT MAKES THE CASE: discourseChronology publishes 0.0468 resting on 25.6% of the route mass on a curated adjudicated fixture; two participants could both report it while one rests on 90% of their route and the other on 5%. TWO BREAKS WERE FOUND BY TWO DIFFERENT ROUTES BEFORE THIS LANDED - the chief's merged-tree gate found embed-bench/report.scala passing MassRatio where Option[Double] was required; the AUTHOR found CodecGens breaking codecJVM, which the chief's gate had not covered because the reference scope was computed for the headline commit rather than the union of the stack. That omission is now AGENTS.md rule 3. FOLLOW-UP LANDED SEPARATELY at 5ab03b1: zz-worktree-local.sbt was swept into aee72ed and is now untracked and ignored - it is a grakern worktree workaround (sbt-git is not a plugin of this project and nothing in build.sbt reads its settings), and it does not belong on main because gitUncommittedChanges := false and gitHeadCommit := None make the build assert unconditionally that the tree is clean and has no HEAD.
